svg.title: Podium architecture: module wiring
svg.desc: Browser (index.html, app.js, orb.js, dashboard.js) talks WebRTC audio and a data channel to a LiveKit Cloud room; the agent process's PodiumOrchestrator joins the same room and drives Deepgram nova-3 STT, LiveKit Inference coach and judge models, Rime over WebSocket for live speech and over REST to pre-synthesize lines; the pure-Python analysis lane (metrics.py, judge.py, render.py) produces V1/V2/V3 contrast clips through Rime REST, which loop back to the orchestrator as clip paths and pre-rendered clips.
svg.text: line ahead of its UI message
